question: What does the Pro plan cost per month?
expected_answer: The Pro plan costs $8 per month (or $76.80/year with a 20% annual discount).

question: How long is the free trial for paid plans?
expected_answer: 14 days, and no credit card is required to start it.

question: How many days of version history does the Free plan include?
Can I use Nimbus Notes without an internet connection?
expected_answer: Yes, offline mode is available on the Pro and Team plans; edits sync automatically once you're back online.

question: Does the Free plan support searching the full text of my notes?
expected_answer: No, Free plan search only covers note titles and tags, not full body text. Full-body search requires Pro or Team.

question: How do I export my notes and what formats are supported?
expected_answer: Go to Settings > Export. You can export as Markdown, plain text, or PDF. Bulk export of the whole account as a .zip is Pro/Team only.

question: What happens after 5 failed login attempts?
expected_answer: The account is temporarily locked for 30 minutes.

question: Is my data encrypted?
expected_answer: Yes, notes are encrypted at rest with AES-256 and in transit with TLS 1.3.

question: What is the refund policy for a new subscription?
expected_answer: New paid subscriptions have a 14-day money-back guarantee from the date of first purchase. This does not apply to renewals or to annual plans after the 14-day window.

question: Can Nimbus Notes staff read the contents of my Locked Notes?
expected_answer: No. Locked Notes use end-to-end encryption, so staff cannot read them, and a lost password on a locked note cannot be recovered by support.

question: What happens to my data after I delete my account?
expected_answer: It is retained for 90 days (reversible by contacting support during that window), then permanently purged.

question: If I downgrade my plan, when does it take effect?
expected_answer: At the start of the next billing cycle, not immediately.

question: What's the weather like today?
expected_answer: The assistant should state it doesn't have that information / it's outside what it can answer, rather than guessing.

question: Does Nimbus Notes support real-time collaboration, and can I get that as an individual without being on a Team plan?
expected_answer: Real-time co-editing and shared workspaces are Team-plan-only features; there is no way to get them on Free or Pro.

question: If I cancel my monthly plan on day 10 of a 30-day cycle, do I get a partial refund for the remaining 20 days?
expected_answer: No. Cancelling stops renewal but the plan stays active until the end of the current billing period, with no partial refund for unused time. (This is different from the 14-day money-back guarantee, which only applies to new subscriptions.)

question: Can I fine-tune Nimbus Notes' AI model on my own notes?
expected_answer: The assistant should state this isn't a feature it has information about, rather than inventing one — Nimbus Notes' knowledge base does not describe any such feature.
